900.3.10(365).explanation: This site-specific exception sets a 0.3 m side setback, 2.4 m from a street-side lot line, and 22.0 m from the original centreline of Bellamy, Brimley, McCowan, Midland or Danforth Rd. It also sets frontage and lot-area minimums for semi-detached houses, duplexes and detached houses on named Winter Ave. and Commonwealth Ave. lots, and a density permission for named Winter Ave. and Huntington Ave. lots.

900.3.10(1332).explanation: This exception lets a building that existed in 1977 above the height limit be replaced at the same height, allows a rear addition to a pre-1953 detached house up to FSI 0.69 under conditions, bars high platforms from projecting into front or rear yards, and bars a front-wall vehicle entrance on lots 7.6 m wide or less.

900.3.10(119).explanation: This exception sets a 7.5 m front setback, 1.2 m side setback, 5.7 m street-side setback and a 22.5 m rear setback where the rear abuts a Guildcrest Drive lot, requires compliance with exception 1462, and keeps parts of the former Scarborough by-law 9676 in force.
